pilot_drills.prompt: Complete: I am going to ___ to California.

Complete: I am going to ___ my parents.
Choose the verb used with my parents in the frozen source.
Rewrite as a negative: I am going to see my parents.
Recognize the focus phrase: I am going to see.
Complete: We are going to ___ a party.
Choose the frozen source verb used before a party.
Rewrite as a negative plan using not going to.
Recognize the focus phrase: We are going to have.
Put the three frozen narrative sentences in order.
Identify which sentence mentions California.
Identify which sentence mentions parents.
Identify which sentence mentions a party.
Distinguish present state from planned future intention.
Identify the auxiliary + going to pattern.
Identify the approved negative pattern.
Check that California remains untranslated as a modern toponym.
Confirm no new HNK lexeme was introduced.
Confirm bridge content was not silently altered.
Confirm transliteration/provenance warnings were reviewed.
